description: This file defines the SocketAwaitableEventArgs class, which provides an awaitable wrapper around SocketAsyncEventArgs for asynchronous socket operations, integrating with the Orleans networking infrastructure.

classes.name: SocketAwaitableEventArgs
classes.description: An awaitable class that extends SocketAsyncEventArgs to support async/await pattern with custom scheduling and completion handling within Orleans networking.

methods.name: GetAwaiter
methods.description: Returns the object itself as an awaiter for use with the await keyword.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the asynchronous operation has completed.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Finalizes the asynchronous operation, throws if there was a socket error, and returns the number of bytes transferred.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Schedules the continuation to be run when the operation completes, using Task.Run if already completed.

methods.name: UnsafeOnCompleted
methods.description: Schedules the continuation without capturing the execution context, delegating to OnCompleted.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Marks the operation as complete and triggers the continuation.

methods.name: OnCompleted (override)
methods.description: Overrides the base method to schedule the continuation via the custom scheduler, ensuring thread safety.
